skirmish.menu.title: Skirmish
skirmish.module.combat.name: Combat tracker
skirmish.module.combat.description: Counts damage, hits and totems in every fight. Required by KillCam and KillCard.
skirmish.module.combat.setting.kill_wind: A death counts as my kill if my last hit landed at most this long before it.
skirmish.module.combat.setting.fight_tim: A fight ends after this long without hits in either direction.
skirmish.module.combat.setting.players_o: Track fights with players only (off: any living entity).
skirmish.module.waypoints.name: Waypoints
skirmish.module.waypoints.description: Labels with distance in the world and an arrow to the selected waypoint. Stored per server and dimension.
skirmish.module.killcam.name: KillCam
skirmish.module.killcam.description: Keeps the last seconds around you in memory and replays them from the side after you die.
skirmish.module.clanshare.name: ClanShare
skirmish.module.clanshare.description: Encrypts coordinates for your clan: members see a marker, everyone else sees gibberish.
skirmish.module.gearinspector.name: Gear inspector
skirmish.module.gearinspector.descriptio: Shows armor, enchantments and durability of the player you are aiming at.
skirmish.module.anvilcalc.name: Anvil calculator
skirmish.module.anvilcalc.description: Finds the cheapest order to combine enchanted books.
skirmish.module.killcard.name: KillCard
skirmish.module.killcard.description: After a kill, saves a PNG card with the fight summary.
skirmish.waypoint.click_select: Click to select for the arrow
skirmish.waypoints.title: Waypoints (this server)
skirmish.waypoints.name: Name
skirmish.waypoints.empty: No waypoints on this server yet
skirmish.module.waypoints.setting.max_la: Hide labels farther than this. 0 = no limit.
